Application Fee

OnlyJobs® :  How to Activate DIGILOCKER Account Through School Security Pin 2026

  • CBSE has issued a notice on 14 April 2026, in which it has been said that the annual board examination year 2026 of class 10 and 12 results / certificates and migration will be through Digilocker.
  • All CBSE Board Class 10 and 12 students who have also appeared in the exam will have to create their own account in Digilocker.
  • CBSE Board students can create their account in Digilocker by following some simple steps - which CBSE has also mentioned in its notice.
  • Once the account is created in Digilocker, candidates can also download their CBSE Board 2026 result, marksheet, certificate and migration online after the issue.
  • Step by Step to Activate CBSE Student to Activate Digilocker Account.
  • Step 1 : The student will get the link to do DigiLocker Account Confirmation in the Some Useful Important Links section at the bottom of this page.
  • Step 2 :To confirm DigiLocker Account, the student has to first select his class such as X or XII.
  • Step 3 : After that the student has to enter the code of his school. If the school code is not known, then they can see it in their admit card.
  • Step 4 : After that the student has to enter his/her board exam roll number.
  • Step 5 : After that Enter 6 Digit PIN provided by your school.
  • Step 6 : After that the candidate has to enter his mobile number.
  • Step 7 : An OTP will be received on the mobile number given by the student, he will have to enter it.
  • Step 8 : DigiLocker Account Confirmation process will be completed.
  • Now waiting for the candidate, whenever the CBSE Board will release the result of 2026 examination, candidates can also check their result through Digilocker as well as download the passing certificate / mark sheet and migration.

How to Check CBSE Board 10th & 12th Results 2026

  • CBSE Board Exam 2026 result can be released anytime in the month of April / May 2026.
  • After the release of CBSE result of board exam, candidates can check their result through two means.
  • After the release of CBSE result, candidates can check their class 10 and 12 result through CBSEResult and Digilocker whose direct link will be found in OnlyJobs Some Useful Important Link of this page.
  • The student must have his/her roll number to view the CBSE Result 2026.
  • All the registered students of CBSE Exam 2026 must activate their Digilocker account.

CBSE CTET February 2026 Exam Eligibility Code Details

CTET Primary Level (Class I to V): Eligibility with Code February 2026
  1. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing of 2- year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known) OR
  2. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 45% marks and passed or appearing in of 2- year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known), in accordance with the NCTE (Recognition Norms and Procedure), Regulations, 2002.  OR
  3. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in 4- year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed).
  4. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in 2- year Diploma in Education (Special Education).
  5. More Eligibility Details Read the Notification

CTET Junior Level (Class VI to VIII): Eligibility with Code February 2026
  1. Graduation and passed or appearing in final year of 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known).
  2. At least 50% marks either in Graduation or in Post-Graduation and passed or appearing in Bachelor in Education (B.Ed).
  3. Graduation with at least 45% marks and passed or appearing in Bachelor in Education (B.Ed), in accordance with the NCTE (Recognition Norms and Procedure) Regulations issued from time to time in this regard.
  4. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in of 4- year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed).
  5. Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in of 4- year B.A/B.Sc.Ed or B.A.Ed/B.Sc.Ed.
  6. Graduation with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in  B.Ed. (Special Education)*.
  7. Any candidate having qualified B.Ed. Programme recognized by the NCTE is eligible to appear in TET/CTET. Moreover, as per the existing TET guidelines circulated vide NCTE letter dated 11-02-2011, a person who is pursuing any of the teacher education courses (recognized by the NCTE or the RCI, as the case may be) specified in the NCTE Notification dated 23rd August 2010 is also qualified to appear in the TET/CTET.
  8. Post-Graduation with a minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade and passed or appearing in three-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.

Eligibility Code for NTA NEET 2026 UG

  • NEET UG Code 01: A candidate who is appearing in the qualifying examination, i.e., 12 Standard in 2025 whose result is awaited may apply and take up the said test but he/she shall not be eligible for admission to the MBBS or BDS, if he/she does not pass the qualifying examination with the required pass percentage of marks at the time of first round of Counseling.
  • NEET UG Code 02 : The Higher/Senior Secondary Examination or the Indian School Certificate Examination which is equivalent to 10+2 Higher/Senior Secondary Examination after a period of 12 years study, the last two years of such study comprising of Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Bio-technology (which shall include practical tests in these subjects) and Mathematics or any other elective subject with English at a level not less than the core course for English as prescribed by the National Council of Educational Research and Training after introduction of the 10+2+3 educational structure as recommended by the National Committee on Education.
  • NEET UG Code 03 : The Intermediate/Pre-degree Examination in Science of an Indian University/Board or other recognized examining body with Physics, Chemistry, Biology /Bio-technology (which shall include practical test in these subjects) and also English as a compulsory subject
  • NEET UG Code 04 : The Pre-professional/Pre-medical Examination with Physics ,Chemistry, Biology/Bio-technology & English after passing either the Higher Secondary Examination or the Pre-University or an equivalent examination. The Pre-professional/Pre-medical examination shall include practical test in these subjects and also English as a compulsory subject.
  • NEET UG Code 05 : The first year of the three years’ degree course of a recognized University with Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Bio-technology including practical tests in these subjects provided the examination is a University Examination and candidate has passed the earlier qualifying examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Bio-Technology with English at a level not less than a core course.
  • NEET UG Code 06 : B.Sc.Examination of an Indian University provided that he/she has passed the B.Sc.Examination with not less than two of the subjects Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Botany, Zoology)/Bio-technology and further that he/she has passed the earlier qualifying examination with Physics,Chemistry,Biology and English.
  • NEET UG Code 07: Any other examination which in scope and standard (Last 02 years of 10+2 Study
    comprising of Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Biotechnology; which shall include
    practical test in these subjects) is found to be equivalent to the Intermediate Science
    Examination of an Indian University/Board, taking Physics, Chemistry and
    Biology/Biotechnology including practical tests in each of these subjects and English.

Important Instruction for NEET UG

  • Aadhar Card is Compulsory in All India NTA NEET 2026 Examination
  • Instruction Of Photo  : Candidate Live Photo & Clear Passport Size and 4x6 Size Photo  (Visible Including Ears) with White
  • Background  and Also Enter Your Candidates Name and Photo Taken Date after 01/01/2026
  • For More Details Kindly  SEE NEET UG 2026 Notification

How to Apply SSC One Time Registration OTR Online Form 2025

  • Staff Selection Commission SSC issued a notice on 22 February 2024 saying that they have launched a new website SSC Gov in, in which all the candidates will have to do fresh one time registration (OTR)
  • Step 1 : Open the Website ssc.gov.in or Direct Link Will be in this Page Some Useful Important Links Section
  • Step 2 : Click on New Registration Tab
  • Step 3 : Students will have to give their basic information such as: Name, Father's Name, Mother's Name, Mobile Number, Email Id and High School Class 10 Roll Number.
  • Step 4 : Verify Your OTR Profile Details & Submit Registration.
  • Step 5 : An OTP will be received on the registered email and registered mobile number of the candidate, he will have to enter it.
  • Step 6 : The registration Part I process will be completed, the candidate will see the OTR Registration No. on the screen.
  • Step 7 : In the next step, you will have to change the default password which has been received on your email, after that you will have to login by writing the registration number along with the password which has been received on the email.
  • Step 9 : Candidates should change the default password of OTR registration number with their custom password. Use capital letters, small letters, numbers and special characters while creating the new password which should be at least 08 digits. Additionally, two security questions will also have to be selected, so that if you forget your password in future, you can recover your password with the help of the security question.
  • Step 10 :  After changing the password, the candidate will have to login again, after that the information about his nationality, category, Visible Identification Mark and information about permanent and local address will be entered in the form.
  • Step 11 : The last step is that here you have to first double check all the information by clicking on the preview button of OTR, after checking, if there is any error then correct it, otherwise click on the declare button and submit the form finally.
  • Step 12 : The registration process of SSC OTR has now been completed, the candidate will be able to see the dashboard whenever any new recruitment comes, or the candidate can also get the information about admit card and result by logging into the SSC dashboard.
  • Our team has also shown a video on how to do SSC one time registration, which you can watch and do your new registration by following the step by step process: SSC OTR Registration Kaise Kare Video Dekhe
  • For more information, you have to complete the notice issued to SSC OTR.

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has published the Stenographer Grade ‘C’ & ‘D’ Examination 2026 Notification on 24th April 2026. The recruitment drive aims to fill approximately 731 tentative vacancies for Stenographer Grade C (Group B Non-Gazetted) & Grade D (Group C) posts in various Ministries/Departments/Organizations of Govt. of India. Candidates aged 18-30 years (Grade C) / 18-27 years (Grade D) as on 01.08.2026, with 12th standard pass & stenography skills, are eligible to apply online only at ssc.gov.in from 24 April to 15 May 2026

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Staff Selection Commission (SSC), Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions, Govt. of India has released detailed advertisement (F. No. E1/32/026-C-2) for Stenographer Grade ‘C’ & ‘D’ posts across Ministries/Departments/Organizations including Attached/Subordinate offices & Statutory bodies. Download the official detailed notification from SSC website to check tentative vacancies (to be updated), eligibility, skill test standards, fee & application process before applying

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Vacancy 2026

Approx. 731 tentative vacancies announced for Stenographer Grade C & D (exact post/category-wise to be updated on ssc.gov.in; State/Zone-wise vacancies not collected by SSC). Vacancies for ESM reserved only for Group C (Grade D). Updated vacancy details will be available on SSC website. Final vacancies: 232 Grade C + 1483 Grade D = 1715 (per some sources, subject to confirmation).

Note: No region-wise table provided in notification; check ssc.gov.in for updates.

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Nationality: Indian citizen / Subject of Nepal/Bhutan / Tibetan refugee (before 01.01.1962) / Person of Indian origin from specified countries (eligibility certificate required).

Stenographer Grade C & D 12th Standard or equivalent from recognized Board/University. Stenography skill mandatory (tested in Skill Test).

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Selection Process 2026

  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 200 marks (objective; General Intelligence & Reasoning 50, GA 50, English 100); qualifying: 30% UR, 25% OBC/EWS, 20% others.

  • Skill Test in Stenography (Qualifying): Grade C: 100 wpm (English/Hindi); Grade D: 80 wpm (English/Hindi) (10 min dictation; 40% UR/EWS, 35% others pass marks).

  • Document Verification (DV) by User Departments.

  • Final Merit: Based on CBT marks (category-wise); All India Service Liability.

Pre-Employment Medical Exam (esp. for BRO posts with Physical Efficiency Test).

SSC Stenographer 2026 Documents Required

Candidates must upload/produce originals at DV:

  • Recent passport size photo & signature.

  • Matric certificate (DOB proof).

  • 12th mark sheet & certificate.

  • Caste/EWS/PwBD/ESM certificate (GOI format).

  • NOC (Govt./PSU employees).

  • ID proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID etc.).

  • Others (name change, scribe cert. if applicable).

How to Apply for SSC Stenographer 2026

  • Apply online only via ssc.gov.in → One Time Registration (OTR) → Stenographer 2026 section.

  • Capture live photo (webcam), upload signature (10-20 KB JPEG).

  • Fill details, pay fee (if applicable), submit.

  • Correction window: 20-21 May 2026 (charges apply).

  • Print application for records; active email/mobile required.

  • Last date: 15 May 2026 (23:59 Hrs)

The exact crucial date for determining age, category-wise relaxations and upper age limits for each post are specified in the SSC Phase‑XIV/2026 notification, and candidates must refer to the post details before applying.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Application Fee 2026

  • For General / OBC / EWS candidates: ₹100/- examination fee to be paid online.
  • For Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex‑Servicemen candidates eligible for reservation: No fee (Exempted) as per SSC rules.
  • Payment Mode: Online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, RuPay Credit or Debit Cards within the prescribed time limit.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Selection Process 2026

  • Computer Based Examination (CBE): SSC will conduct separate CBTs for Matriculation, 10+2 and Graduation & above level posts consisting of Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions with 100 questions (25 each from General Intelligence, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English Language).
  • Exam Duration: 60 minutes for general candidates and 80 minutes for eligible candidates using scribes; there is negative marking of 0.50 marks for each wrong answer.
  • Skill Tests: Skill Tests like Typing/Data Entry/Computer Proficiency Tests etc., where prescribed for particular posts, will be of qualifying nature and conducted by the User Departments.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called by the respective User Departments for Document Verification and final selection as per post-wise and category-wise vacancies.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Salary 2026

Pay Component Details
Pay Level Selection Posts are placed in Pay Levels 1 to 8 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, varying according to the post and User Department.
Approximate Pay Basic pay as per level plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance and other admissible allowances as per Central Government norms.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Documents Required

No supporting documents/certificates are required to be uploaded at the time of online application for SSC Selection Post Phase 14; however, candidates must possess the original documents for verification.

  • Matriculation, 10+2 and Graduation mark sheets and certificates to support educational qualifications.
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC, EWS certificate, PwBD certificate and Ex‑Servicemen documents where applicable, in prescribed formats.
  • Photo identity proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Driving Licence, Passport etc. for identity verification at exam and DV stages.

How to Apply for SSC Recruitment 2026 (Selection Post Phase 14)

  • Candidates must apply online only through the SSC website https://ssc.gov.in or the mySSC mobile app within the application window from 13-04-2026 to 04-05-2026 (up to 23:00 Hrs).
  • Register on the SSC portal (One‑time registration) if not already registered, using a valid mobile number and email ID, then log in to apply for Selection Post Phase 14.
  • Fill in all details in the online form such as personal information, category, educational qualification, post preferences and exam centre choices accurately as per original documents.
  • Upload scanned photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as specified in the notification.
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) through the available online payment modes before 05-05-2026 (up to 23:00 Hrs).
  • Use the “Application Form Correction Window” between 11-05-2026 and 13-05-2026 to correct mistakes if required and pay the correction charges as applicable.
  • After successful submission and fee payment, download/print the final submitted application form for future reference; candidates will be provisionally admitted to the examination subject to verification at later stages.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Before filling the online application, candidates must read the full SSC Phase‑XIV/2026 Selection Posts notice carefully and ensure that they meet all eligibility conditions for the posts they apply for.
  • All particulars filled in the online application must match the original certificates, and any mismatch detected at Document Verification will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Application fee is non‑refundable and no request for change in category, post, exam centre or any other details will be entertained after final submission.
  • Provisional admission to the exam does not imply final selection; final appointment is subject to verification of eligibility, documents and other conditions by User Departments.
  • Candidates are advised to visit SSC’s official website and the websites of User Departments regularly for updates on exam schedule, admit cards, results and DV schedule; no separate correspondence will generally be made.
  • PwBD, Ex‑Servicemen and other reserved category candidates must possess and produce valid certificates in the prescribed format at the time of Document Verification to avail reservation/relaxation benefits.
  • Any form of canvassing, use of unfair means or providing false information will lead to disqualification and possible legal action; SSC’s decision in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding.

How to Apply for BPCL Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply ONLINE only through the official BPCL website. No other mode of application will be accepted. The online application process is open from 18 April 2026 to 17 May 2026 (23:59 hrs).

Step-by-Step Application Process

  1. Check Eligibility: Ensure that you meet all the eligibility criteria including educational qualification, age limit, and work experience before applying. No eligibility-related queries will be entertained.
  2. Keep Documents Ready: Prepare scanned copies (PDF format) of the following documents:
    • Date of Birth Proof (Class 10th/12th Certificate)
    • Educational Qualification Certificates (Marksheet + Degree/Diploma)
    • Work Experience Certificates (with job role, duration, salary, etc.)
    • Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable)
    • Recent Passport Size Photograph (latest, not older than April 2026)
    • Scanned Signature (not in CAPITAL letters)
    • Last 3 Salary Slips (combined in one PDF)
  3. Register Online:
    • Visit the BPCL Careers page and click on “Apply Online”
    • Click on “New Registration”
    • Enter Name, Email ID, and Mobile Number
    • Note the Registration Number and Password generated
  4. Fill Application Form:
    • Login using credentials
    • Fill personal, educational, and experience details carefully
    • Use “Save & Next” to verify details
  5. Upload Documents: Upload photograph, signature, and required documents as per prescribed format.
  6. Preview Application: Carefully review all details using the Preview Tab before final submission. No changes will be allowed after submission.
  7. Pay Application Fee:
    • Pay via Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI / Net Banking
    • Ensure payment status shows “Completed”
    • Take a printout of payment receipt
  8. Final Submission: Click on “Submit” to complete the application process.

Important Instructions

  • Apply only once; multiple applications may lead to rejection.
  • No hard copy of application needs to be sent to BPCL.
  • Ensure all details match original documents; mismatch may lead to disqualification.
  • Keep your registered email ID and mobile number active for future communication.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Pay & Other Benefits

In addition to the consolidated monthly pay mentioned against each post, MECON offers a comprehensive benefits package to all contractual employees. Employees deployed at site/project locations receive a Site Allowance of 7.5% of pay, while those at Metro locations receive a Metro Allowance of 2.5% of pay. An annual increment on consolidated pay (rounded to the next ten rupees) is provided subject to company rules. Medical facilities including OPD and IPD treatment are available at Ispat Hospital, Ranchi, for employees posted at Ranchi (covering self, spouse, and 2 dependent children). For other locations, a company-retained doctor provides free consultation. Additionally, reimbursement of up to ₹15,000 per year towards Mediclaim premium (₹4,00,000 on floater basis) is available as per company policy.

Company accommodation (family or bachelor) may be provided based on availability at applicable charges; if not availed, HRA at 5% of consolidated pay is payable. Leave entitlements include Casual Leave (12 days/year), Earned Leave (18 days/year, accumulation up to 45 days), Half Pay Leave (14 days/year with commutation on medical certificate), and Maternity Leave as applicable to regular employees. National, Festival, and Restricted Holidays (4 nos.) are as per regular employee norms. All employees are covered under a Group Personal Accident Policy with a Sum Insured of ₹25 Lakhs.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Definition of Work Experience

Work experience will be counted only if it is in a full-time job on a regular salary basis and in the relevant area as stipulated against the respective post. Intermittent or freelance experience will not be counted. Entrepreneurial experience is also not eligible. For Management Trainees, Executive Trainees, and Graduate Trainees, only the on-the-job training period served in PSUs will be counted towards experience. Articleship, internship, academic projects, teaching, and research experience will not be considered as post-qualification experience. However, the period of apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act will be counted towards the required post-qualification experience. All experience claimed must be substantiated with documentary evidence as specified; self-declarations regarding the nature of work or relevance of experience will not be accepted.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Documentary Evidence for Work Experience

Candidates must provide valid work experience certificates for all past employments mentioned in the application form. These certificates must clearly mention the date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and specific areas of experience with relevance to the applied post. In the absence of a certificate from any past employer, the experience from that employer will not be counted, and the candidature may be rejected if minimum experience is not met. For current employment, candidates must submit an Experience Certificate or Offer/Appointment Letter along with Pay Slips for the last 3 months from the date of the advertisement. Identity Card proving continuity of employment may also be submitted. Non-submission of these documents may result in rejection. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will lead to summary rejection.

Employment Type Required Documents
Past Employment Experience certificate(s) with date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and relevance to the applied post
Current Employment Experience Certificate OR Offer/Appointment Letter + Last 3 months Pay Slips + Identity Card (to prove continuity)

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit & Relaxation

The upper age limit for each post is 50 years for General (UR) and EWS category candidates, as calculated on the cut-off date of 23.03.2026. Age relaxation is provided as per Government of India guidelines. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates get a relaxation of 3 years, SC/ST candidates get 5 years, and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) get relaxation of 10 years (General), 13 years (OBC-NCL), or 15 years (SC/ST).

Category Age Relaxation
General (UR) / EWS Upper Age Limit as per post (50 years for all posts in this recruitment)
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years relaxation
SC / ST 5 years relaxation
PwD - General (UR) 10 years relaxation
PwD - OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 13 years relaxation
PwD - SC / ST 15 years relaxation
J&K Domicile (01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989) 5 years relaxation
Ex-Servicemen As per extant Govt. of India guidelines

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Reservations & Relaxations

Reservations for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), PwD (Persons with Disability - 40% or above), and EWS candidates are provided as per Government of India guidelines. Reservation for PwD is on a horizontal basis. SC, ST, and OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR category posts will be considered on General category merit - no age relaxation or fee waiver applies to them in such cases. OBC (NCL) candidates must produce a valid certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India; the certificate must not be more than 1 year old as on the date of advertisement. EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority (such as District Magistrate, Revenue Officer not below Tehsildar rank, etc.) in the prescribed format available on MECON's website. The crucial date for the Income and Asset Certificate is the closing date for online applications.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying under UR, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), or EWS category are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of ₹500 (Rupees Five Hundred only). Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwD, or Ex-Servicemen categories, as well as internal MECON candidates, are fully exempted from paying any fee.

The application fee must be paid online through the payment gateway provided on MECON's official website. No other mode of payment (such as demand draft, postal order, or cash) is accepted. Once the fee is paid, candidates must click the "Verify" button to update the application status to "Submitted." Fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates are strongly advised to verify their eligibility before making payment. Applications submitted without fee or with insufficient fee will be rejected.

Category Application Fee
UR / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS ₹500 (Non-Refundable)
SC / ST / PwD / Ex-Servicemen / Internal Candidates NIL (Exempted)

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Selection Mode

The selection process for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 is through Walk-In-Interview. Walk-In-Interviews will be conducted at four locations - Delhi, Ranchi, Kolkata, and Bangalore - and the specific dates and times will be published on the MECON Careers page. Candidates must apply online before appearing for the interview.

On the date of the Walk-In-Interview, document scrutiny will be undertaken; if any claim in the application is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview and no TA will be reimbursed. The final list of selected candidates will be published on MECON's website and communicated via registered email ID only. MECON reserves the right to change the mode of selection at its discretion.

Stage Details
Step 1 Submit Online Application on MECON website between 27.04.2026 and 11.05.2026
Step 2 Check MECON Careers page for Walk-In-Interview schedule (date, time & venue)
Step 3 Appear for Walk-In-Interview at Delhi / Ranchi / Kolkata / Bangalore with all original documents
Step 4 Document Scrutiny on day of Walk-In-Interview
Step 5 Personal Interview
Step 6 Medical Examination (before joining)
Final Result Published on MECON website and communicated via registered email

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Travelling Allowance (TA) for Interview

Outstation candidates who appear for the Walk-In-Interview are entitled to reimbursement of travelling allowance (TA) for to-and-fro travel by the shortest route from their mailing address (as mentioned in the application) to the interview venue. TA will be paid at III Tier AC (3A) / Chair Car (CC) rail fare rates, or ₹7 per km by road, whichever is less, subject to production of original tickets/receipts and/or boarding passes. Rail fare will be at regular (non-Tatkal/non-premium Tatkal) rates only. Internal MECON candidates will be governed by company service rules.

Candidates should note that scrutiny of applications is conducted on the interview date itself - if any claim is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. TA forms must be submitted along with proof of travel, bank account number, and IFSC code of the bank branch for payment processing.

Grade Travelling Allowance
Contract III Tier A/C (3A) / CC by rail OR ₹7 per km by road - whichever is less, subject to production of ticket/receipt and/or boarding pass. Regular rail fare only (No premium/Tatkal).

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Place of Posting

The initial place of posting for each post code is as listed in the table below. Post Codes 01 to 23 are for Rampura Agucha Mines / Debari, Rajasthan; Post Codes 24 to 25 for Bangalore, Karnataka; Post Codes 26 to 27 for Bacheli, Chhattisgarh; Post Code 28 for Ranchi, Jharkhand; Post Codes 29 to 35 for Malanjkhand, Madhya Pradesh; and Post Codes 36 to 60 for Burnpur, West Bengal. Candidates should note that the initial place of posting is indicative only - MECON reserves the right to post selected candidates at any project site, location, or office of the company based on organizational requirements. Candidates must be prepared for transfers/postings anywhere in India as per management discretion.

Sl. No. Post Code(s) Place of Posting
1 01 to 23 Rampura Agucha Mines / Debari, Rajasthan
2 24 to 25 Bangalore, Karnataka
3 26 to 27 Bacheli, Chhattisgarh
4 28 Ranchi, Jharkhand
5 29 to 35 Malanjkhand, Madhya Pradesh
6 36 to 60 Burnpur, West Bengal

How to Apply for MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026

Applications for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only through MECON's official website (www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Apply Online). No offline or postal applications will be accepted. Candidates must apply between 27 April 2026 and 11 May 2026. During the online application process, candidates must upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), a signature image in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), and self-attested PDF copies of all required documents.

If multiple documents need to be merged, they must be combined into a single PDF not exceeding 1 MB. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will result in summary rejection. No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application, so candidates must take utmost care before final submission.

Government/PSU employees must forward their application through Proper Channel or produce an NOC at the time of the interview; failure to do so means they will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. Hard copies of the online application and all required documents must be brought on the date of the Walk-In-Interview.

Documents to be uploaded online:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
  • Signature in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
  • Matriculation/Secondary Board certificate or Municipal Birth Certificate (proof of age)
  • Final/Provisional Graduation and Post-Graduation certificates (as applicable)
  • All semester/year-wise mark sheets or consolidated mark sheet
  • Work experience certificates/documents as per Para 6 of the notification
  • PAN Card and Aadhaar Card
  • Caste certificate - OBC (NCL) / EWS / SC / ST (as applicable; OBC certificate not more than 1 year old)
  • PwD certificate in prescribed Govt. of India format (if applicable)
  • Income & Asset Certificate for EWS candidates as per DoPT OM No.36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31.01.2019
  • Discharge/Service Certificate (for Ex-Servicemen)
  • J&K Domicile Certificate (if applicable)
  • Meritorious Sportsperson Certificate (if applicable)

Important Instructions for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All documents must be self-attested; third-party attestation is not required unless specifically mentioned.
  • Original certificates/documents must be produced at the time of the Walk-In-Interview.
  • No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application.
  • Government/PSU employees must produce NOC from present employer at interview.
  • Certificates in languages other than Hindi/English must be accompanied by a certified translation.
  • Candidates must maintain a valid and active email ID and mobile number for at least 1 year - all future communications will be through email only.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Ranchi (Jharkhand) only.
  • MECON's decision in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding.

Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before applying for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026, candidates must ensure they meet all the prescribed eligibility conditions including educational qualification, experience, and other requirements for the respective post. SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against unreserved posts are not entitled to any relaxation in age limit, experience, etc. OBC candidates must submit a certificate stating they do not belong to the creamy layer. The post-wise educational qualification and experience requirements are given below.

  • Nationality: Eligible Indian Citizens only.
  • Punjabi/Regional Language: Not applicable; however, application forms must be typed in English/Hindi.
  • PwBD Typing Exemption: As per DoPT OM No. 14020/1/2014-Estt. (D) dated 22 April 2015, PwBD candidates who are otherwise qualified to hold clerical posts and are certified as being unable to type may be exempted from the typing test subject to furnishing Medical Certificate in prescribed format as Annexure-II.

Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Selection Process 2026

The selection process for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 involves scrutiny of applications, written test, and skill/practical/physical test wherever applicable. All applications will be scrutinised in terms of age limit, minimum qualification, documents and certificates. Eligible candidates will be issued call letters for the written test.

The written test will be based on minimum education qualification. Shortlisted candidates will then be called for skill/practical/physical test wherever applicable. Merely fulfilling basic selection criteria does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test. Selected candidates will be subject to "All India Service Liability". The detailed selection process is given below.

2. Written Test 100% weightage; Question cum answer paper will be in English and Hindi; there will be simultaneous conduct of test for all categories
3. Skill / Practical / Physical Test Qualifying in nature; required candidates shortlisted based on merit/category in written test will be called for this test

How to Apply for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026

The application process for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Eligible candidates can apply to any of the Air Force Stations of their choice subject to the vacancies and qualifications. The application as per Annexure-I, duly supported with required documents, must reach the concerned Air Force Station as per choice within 30 days from the date of publication of this advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar. The step-by-step process to apply offline is given below.

  • Download and fill the Application Form as per the prescribed Proforma (Annexure-I) given in the advertisement. The application form must be filled/typed in English or Hindi.
  • Affix a recent passport-size self-attested photograph on the application form. Also attach two passport-size photographs (same as affixed on the form).
  • Attach self-attested copies of all documents in support of educational qualification, age, technical qualification, Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) certificate (if applicable), experience certificate, and Caste Certificate issued by the competent civil authorities in case of SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates.
  • In case of appointment of OBC candidates against reserved quota, their caste should be listed under Central List of OBCs. OBC candidates seeking reservation must submit a certificate to the effect that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer.
  • In case of ex-serviceman, a self-attested photocopy of the discharge book must be submitted along with the application.
  • EWS candidates must ensure that the Income & Asset Certificate is valid for Financial Year 2026-2027 (issued on the basis of income for Financial Year 2025-2026).
  • Attach a self-addressed envelope with stamps of Rs. 10/- pasted. Address should be typed in English/Hindi.
  • Mention clearly on the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________ AND CATEGORY ________"
  • Send the complete application by post to the concerned Air Force Station/Unit's postal address within 30 days from the date of publication of this advertisement.
  • Candidates intending to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.

Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Application Form 2026

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 must use the prescribed Application Proforma (Annexure-I) published in the official notification. The application must be duly filled, supported with all required self-attested documents, and sent by post to the concerned Air Force Station/Unit within 30 days from the date of publication in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.

The centre for examination/skill/practical/physical test will be intimated to the candidate in due course and may be different from the place to which the application was sent. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the written test/skill/practical/physical test. Candidates must bring original certificates and copies of annexure attached with the application at the time of the skill/practical/physical test.

Send Application by Post to: The respective Postal Address of the concerned Air Force Station/Unit as mentioned in the official notification.

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates are advised to read all instructions carefully before applying for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026. Non-compliance with any of the instructions may result in rejection of the application. The Air Officer Commanding/Station Commander/Commanding Officer of the concerned Air Force Station has the right to reject any application without assigning any reason. The key instructions are listed below.

  • Applications received prior to the date of publication of this notification and after the closing date will not be entertained and will be rejected. IAF will not be held responsible for any postal delay.
  • Separate application for each post should be forwarded. Mention clearly on the envelope "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF _______ AND CATEGORY _______".
  • All documents must be self-attested. Application form must be duly typed in English/Hindi with a recent passport-size photograph.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against unreserved posts are not entitled to any relaxation in age limit, experience, etc.
  • The option for scribe to PwBD candidates will be applicable as per DoPT OM No. 29-6/2019-DD-III dated 10 Aug 2022.
  • PwBD candidates with temporary disability (falling under "likely to improve" category) as per Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment OM No. 18-25/2024-Policy dated 17 Dec 2025 are not eligible for reservation. Only "progressive, non-progressive or not likely to improve" PwBD candidates are eligible for reservation.
  • There will be simultaneous conduct of test for all categories. The responsibility of deciding the category for which the candidate would like to appear will be the choice of the applicant himself. No separate exam will be conducted for candidates applying for more than one category if the exams are held on the same date.
  • The Air Officer Commanding/Station Commander/Commanding Officer has the right to change the number of vacancies/reservation status at any Air Force Station at any time before selection.
  • Selected candidates will be subject to "All India Service Liability".
  • No TA/DA will be paid to attend the written test/skill/practical/physical test.
  • Candidates must bring original certificates, copies of annexure attached with application, educational qualification/technical qualification and experience certificates at the time of skill/practical/physical test. The crucial date for determining validity of documents/certificates will be on or before the last date of receipt of application.

OPaL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

ONGC Petro additions Limited (OPaL) has officially published the apprenticeship advertisement inviting applications from qualified candidates for engagement as Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973 for a period of one year across multiple trade/discipline/degree categories at its work centres in Dahej, Vadodara, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, and Delhi. The age limit for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is between 18 and 30 years, calculated as on the crucial date of 01.08.2026. SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Fee

The application fee for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is ₹100 for General (UR), OBC, and EWS male candidates. Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen eligible for reservation are fully exempted from payment of fee.

Fee can be paid online only through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, or RuPay Debit Card. The fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be adjusted against any other examination. Candidates must ensure their fee payment is complete - if the fee is not received by SSC, the application status will show as "Incomplete" and will be summarily rejected.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Scheme of Examination

The SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 will consist of two papers. Paper-I is a Computer Based Examination with objective-type multiple choice questions, divided into two sections - General Hindi and General English - each carrying 100 marks with a sectional timer of 1 hour. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.

Based on performance in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise to appear in Paper-II, which is a descriptive paper testing translation and essay writing skills in both Hindi and English, carrying 200 marks. Marks scored in Paper-I will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple shifts. Tentative Answer Keys will be uploaded after the exam, and candidates can submit online representations within the given time on payment of ₹50 per question (non-refundable).

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 consists of two stages. In the first stage, Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) is used to shortlist candidates category-wise for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I are 30% for UR, 25% for OBC/EWS, and 20% for all other categories. In the second stage, Paper-II (Descriptive) is conducted for shortlisted candidates.

For the final merit list, 50% weightage is given to Paper-I scores and 100% weightage to Paper-II marks. Final selection and allocation of Ministry/Department/Organization is based on merit-cum-preference of posts/departments exercised by candidates through an Online Option Form. In case of a tie, it is resolved by total marks in Paper-II, then date of birth (older preferred), and finally alphabetical order of names. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years and all posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL).

3. Final Merit 50% weightage of Paper-I + 100% weightage of Paper-II marks
4. Post Preference & Allocation Online Option Form to be submitted before FRTA; merit-cum-preference based allocation
5. Document Verification Conducted by User Departments/Organizations after declaration of final result

Tie-Breaking Order

1st Higher total marks in Paper-II
2nd Date of Birth - older candidate preferred
3rd Alphabetical order of names of candidates

How to Apply for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026

The application process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is entirely online at https://ssc.gov.in. Candidates who have not yet completed their One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC website must do so first, as the earlier OTR from the old website (ssc.nic.in) is not valid for the new portal. Aadhaar-based biometric authentication is available and recommended - candidates who opt for it will not face rejection on grounds of photograph or signature quality.

The application module is designed to capture a live photograph of the candidate through webcam or mobile device; pre-existing photographs must not be submitted. Candidates must also upload their scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB). Applications with blurred or miniature photographs or signatures will be summarily rejected unless Aadhaar authentication has been opted for. Only one online application per candidate is permitted during the normal application period.

  • Visit the official website https://ssc.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR).
  • Login using Registration Number and Password.
  • Click on "Apply" under "Combined Hindi Translators Examination, 2026" in the Live Exam tab.
  • Fill in educational details, additional information (ESM/age relaxation), and examination centre preferences (up to 3 centres).
  • Capture live photograph through webcam/mobile as per instructions (no cap, mask, or spectacles).
  • Upload scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB), dimensions ~6.0 cm (W) × 2.0 cm (H).
  • PwBD/PwD candidates must upload Disability Certificate as per Annexure-I/IA/X/XI, whichever is applicable.
  • Preview the application carefully, complete the declaration, and submit before 14.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card on or before 15.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Form

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 can do so by submitting their application form online only. The application process is entirely online, and candidates must ensure they complete all steps including OTR, form filling, photograph/signature upload, and fee payment before the respective closing dates.

The application form is accessible through the official SSC website after completing One-Time Registration. Candidates are strongly advised to fill the application carefully as only one application is accepted per candidate - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature. Details such as name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth must be filled exactly as they appear in the Matriculation Certificate. After final submission, modifications are only permitted during the correction window (19.05.2026 to 20.05.2026) on payment of correction charges.

Apply Online at: https://ssc.gov.in

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates applying for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 must read the official notification carefully in its entirety before filling and submitting the application form. The English version of the notice will prevail in case of any dispute. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute server load issues on the SSC website. All candidatures are provisional - the Commission does not undertake detailed scrutiny at the time of the written examination, and eligibility will be verified only at the Document Verification stage by the User Departments. Any suppression or misrepresentation of information in the application can lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including after selection. Canvassing in any form will result in immediate disqualification. The decision of the Commission in all matters including eligibility, selection, and allocation of posts is final and binding.

  • All posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL) - candidates may be posted anywhere in India.
  • Regularly check https://ssc.gov.in for updates on exam dates, vacancies, admit cards, and results.

Each vacancy carries a specific role/specialisation requirement (e.g., Batsman, Fast Bowler, Goalkeeper, Midfielder, etc.), and candidates must ensure they apply only for the role matching their sports specialisation. The Bank reserves the right to modify the number of vacancies and their breakup as per its requirement. There is no reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories in this recruitment.

Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The minimum age to apply is 20 years and the maximum age is 28 years for General/EWS category candidates, calculated as on the cut-off date of 01.04.2026.

*This concession will be available only to those meritorious sportspersons who satisfy all other eligibility criteria and furnish a certificate in the form and from an authority prescribed as per the guidelines issued by the Government from time to time.

Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid online at the time of registration regardless of whether the candidate is shortlisted for Field Trials or not. General, EWS, and OBC candidates are required to pay ₹850/- (inclusive of GST) plus applicable payment gateway charges. SC, ST, ESM/DESM (Ex-Servicemen/Disabled Ex-Servicemen), and Women candidates are required to pay ₹175/- (intimation charges only, inclusive of GST) plus applicable payment gateway charges.

Payment can be made through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or any other available online payment mode. Transaction charges, if any, are to be borne by the candidate. Once fee payment is completed successfully, an e-receipt and application form will be generated, which should be printed and retained. The Bank will not entertain any refund requests under any circumstances.

General / EWS / OBC ₹850/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale & Benefits

Selected candidates will be placed in the clerical cadre pay scale as applicable to Customer Service Associates in Bank of Baroda. The starting basic pay is ₹24,050/- per month and the scale progresses through multiple incremental stages over a period of 20 years, reaching up to ₹64,480/-. Increments are applied at different rates at various stages of the pay scale as detailed below.

Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process consists of two main stages: Shortlisting/Screening of applications followed by Field Trials for shortlisted candidates. In the first stage, applications will be screened against the eligibility criteria including educational qualifications, relevant sports experience, domain expertise, and suitability. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for Field Trials - the Bank may call candidates in a ratio as deemed appropriate at its sole discretion. The shortlisting criteria are internal and confidential and will not be shared with candidates.

Shortlisted candidates will be called for Field Trials at a designated venue, the evaluation criteria and qualifying cut-off for which will be determined solely by the Bank. No requests for change of centre, venue, date, or time for Field Trials will be entertained. The Bank's decision on shortlisting and selection at all stages is final and binding. Selected candidates must be Active Sportspersons at the time of joining and fit enough to participate in future tournaments. All selected sportspersons will be required to sign a written undertaking to play for the Bank's team whenever required.

Stage Details
Stage 1: Shortlisting / Screening Applications screened based on eligibility criteria, sports experience, qualifications, and suitability as determined by the Bank. Criteria are internal and confidential.
Stage 2: Field Trials Shortlisted candidates called for Field Trials at designated venue. Evaluation criteria and qualifying cut-off determined solely by the Bank.
Stage 3: Document Verification Original documents to be produced at the time of Field Trials / as called by the Bank. Failure to produce documents will debar candidature.

Obligations of Candidates Recruited as Sportspersons

Obligation Details
Playing for the Bank Sportsperson must play for the Bank / Bank's team whenever and wherever necessary.
Permission for External Events Prior permission required to participate in State / National / International events for other organisations. Bank reserves the right to withhold permission.
Misconduct Refusal to play for the Bank or playing elsewhere without permission will be treated as misconduct and attract disciplinary proceedings.
Written Undertaking All recruited sportspersons must give a written undertaking at the time of appointment.

How to Apply for Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026

The application process is entirely online - no other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must visit the Bank's official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in and apply through the Careers → Current Opportunities section. Before starting the application, candidates must ensure they have a valid personal email ID and active mobile number, a scanned passport-size photograph (20–50 KB, JPG format), a scanned signature in black ink on white paper (10–20 KB, JPG format), and scanned PDF copies of all required documents within the specified file sizes (maximum 500 KB per file).

Candidates are advised to fill the application with utmost care as no changes will be permitted after clicking the SUBMIT button. All details including name, caste, category, date of birth, mobile number, and email ID will be treated as final. Candidates must not submit more than one application; in case of multiple submissions, only the last valid completed application will be retained and fees for earlier applications will be forfeited. A printout of the system-generated application form and e-receipt should be retained for future reference.

  • Visit: www.bankofbaroda.bank.in → Careers → Current Opportunities
  • Register online and fill the application form carefully in all fields.
  • Upload scanned photograph, signature, and all required documents as per specifications in Annexure I.
  • Pay the application fee online via Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI.
  • On successful payment, download and retain the e-receipt and application form printout.
  • Produce original documents at the time of Field Trials as per the document list in Section 10.4 of the notification.

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates must read the full official notification carefully before filling the application. All eligibility criteria are to be met as on the cut-off date of 01.04.2026. Change of category is not permitted at any stage after submission of the online application. Candidates should not furnish false, fabricated, or tampered information at any stage - doing so will result in disqualification or termination even after joining. Any canvassing or creating undue influence will lead to disqualification. All legal proceedings arising from this recruitment can only be instituted at courts in Mumbai. Signatures must remain consistent across all documents and correspondence throughout the recruitment process. Selected candidates will be governed by the Bank's service conditions including provisions related to probation (6 months), confirmation, disciplinary rules, and execution of service bonds. Candidates with adverse credit history, criminal cases, or adverse reports from CIBIL or other credit agencies will be ineligible. The Bank reserves the right to reject, modify, increase/decrease vacancies, or cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.

  • Online application once submitted cannot be modified. Fill with utmost care.
  • Keep email ID and mobile number active till completion of the recruitment process.
  • No request for change of Field Trial centre, venue, date or time will be entertained.
  • Maintain a minimum CIBIL score of 680 at the time of joining.
  • Probation period is 6 months from the date of joining.
  • All announcements / corrigendum will be posted only on the Bank's official website.
  • No separate communication will be sent to candidates who are not shortlisted or not selected.

How to Apply for Sarkari Job Online 2026

  1. Find the right Sarkari Job: Use the vacancy table or sector links above on OnlyJobs. Filter by your qualification — 10th, 12th, Graduate, or Engineering. Check the last date and eligibility carefully.

  2. Read the official notification: Click on the job listing to open the official notification PDF. Read all eligibility conditions — age limit, educational qualification, experience, category relaxations.

  3. Visit the official recruitment website: Never apply through third-party sites. Use the direct official link provided on OnlyJobs. Look for "Apply Online" or "Register" on the official portal.

  4. Register / Create account: Sign up using your valid email ID and active mobile number. Keep your Aadhaar, bank account details, and email accessible.

  5. Fill the application form: Enter personal details, educational qualifications, category (General/OBC/SC/ST/EWS), address, and other required information accurately.

  6. Upload documents: Scan and upload recent passport-size photograph, signature, 10th certificate (for DOB proof), educational certificates, caste certificate (if applicable). Check file size and format (JPG/PDF as specified).

  7. Pay application fee: Pay via Net Banking, UPI, Debit/Credit Card as applicable. Some categories (SC/ST/PwD/Women) may be exempted from fee. Keep the payment receipt.

  8. Submit and save confirmation: Review all details before final submission. After submitting, download the application printout / PDF confirmation with your registration number. Store it safely for admit card, exam, and future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions – Sarkari Job 2026

What is Sarkari Job (सरकारी नौकरी)?

Sarkari Job (सरकारी नौकरी) refers to government employment in India — jobs offered by central government departments, state governments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), banks, railways, defence forces, and other government-funded organisations. These jobs offer permanent employment, fixed salary as per 7th Pay Commission, pension, medical benefits, and unmatched job security.

How to find Sarkari Job vacancy 2026 online?

To find online Sarkari Job vacancies in 2026: (1) Visit OnlyJobs daily for updated notifications. (2) Filter by your qualification — 10th, 12th, Graduate, PG. Sarkari Job salary in 2026 follows the 7th Pay Commission: Group D / MTS: ₹22,000–₹26,000/month. Clerk / Group C: ₹32,000–₹48,000/month. Officer Grade (SSC CGL, Bank PO): ₹47,000–₹85,000/month. IAS/IPS (UPSC): ₹56,100–₹1,44,200 basic pay + DA, HRA, TA, medical and other allowances. State government salaries vary by state pay commission.

Key benefits: (1) Lifelong job security. (2) 7th Pay Commission salary + DA revised biannually. (3) HRA (8–27% of basic). (4) Medical benefits (CGHS). (5) Pension under NPS/OPS. Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs

Eligibility for forest department jobs depends on the post, state and recruitment authority. Below is a general idea of qualification and age for popular posts like Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer. Candidates should always check the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria.

Education Qualification for Forest Guard, Forester, Ranger

  • Forest Guard / Field Guard / Forest Watcher / Beat Guard: Usually 10th pass or 12th pass from a recognized board, knowledge of local language, and basic physical standards as per state rules.
  • Forester / Section Forest Officer / Deputy Forest Ranger: Generally 12th pass or graduate in any stream or science-related subjects, with physical standards and sometimes driving or technical skills depending on the post.
  • Forest Range Officer (RFO) / Forest Ranger / ACF: Normally graduate degree in Science, Agriculture, Forestry, Environmental Science, Engineering or related disciplines, with higher physical standards and sometimes a competitive exam similar to state PCS level.
  • IFS / Indian Forest Service and senior posts (DCF, CF, CCF, PCCF): Filled through UPSC Indian Forest Service Examination and promotions, requiring a graduate degree and all-India competitive selection.

Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Forest Guard / Forester / Field Guard: Minimum age is usually 18 years and maximum age is around 27–30 years, with age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Ex-servicemen and other categories as per government rules.
  • Forest Range Officer / ACF and higher competitive posts: Age limit often ranges from 21 to 32 years (varies by recruitment), with relaxations for reserved categories.
  • Exact age limit, cut-off date and relaxation details always depend on the particular notification, so candidates should verify from the official advertisement before applying.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern

The selection process for Forest Department Jobs 2026 typically includes written examinations, physical tests and document verification. Some posts also conduct medical examination and walking tests due to the demanding nature of field duties.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  • Written Exam: Most Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer recruitments start with a written exam based on objective-type questions (MCQs).
  • PET / PST (Physical Efficiency Test / Physical Standard Test): Candidates who qualify written exam are called for running, walking test, height, chest measurement and other physical parameters as per post and gender.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates of age, qualification, caste, residence, sports/NCC and other documents mentioned in the notification.
  • Medical Examination: Many forest posts require medical fitness to ensure candidates can perform field duties in forests, wildlife areas and difficult terrain.

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

Typical syllabus for written exam may include:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs (national, state-level, environment and forest-related topics)
  • General Hindi / English or regional language (grammar, comprehension, vocabulary)
  • General Mathematics / Quantitative Aptitude (up to 10th or 12th level)
  • General Science and Environmental Studies (forest, wildlife, biodiversity, conservation, climate, basic biology)
  • Reasoning Ability (logical and analytical reasoning)

Exact subject-wise marks, number of questions, negative marking and exam duration will be given in the respective forest department notification.

How to Apply for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Most Forest Department Jobs 2026 applications are accepted either online through official websites or offline via prescribed application forms. Candidates should carefully read the official notification before filling the form.

Online Application Process

  1. Visit the official website of the recruiting body (State Forest Department, State PSC, Staff Selection Board or other government portal).
  2. Find the latest link for Forest Guard / Forester / Forest Range Officer / other forest posts and open the detailed advertisement.
  3. Complete the registration process with basic details like name, mobile number, email ID and verify using OTP if required.
  4. Fill the online application form with personal, educational, address and category information exactly as per documents.
  5. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and other certificates in the prescribed format and size.
  6. Pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI as per your convenience.
  7. Finally, submit the form and take a printout or PDF of the submitted application and payment receipt for future reference.

  • Class 10th and 12th mark sheets and certificates
  • Degree / Diploma certificates for graduate-level posts

  • Domicile / Residence certificate if required by the state
  • NCC, Sports, Ex-serviceman and other quota certificates if applicable
  • Valid ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Passport, etc.)

Forest department jobs are popular among candidates who love nature, wildlife and field work. These jobs offer job security, government benefits and a chance to work in forest conservation, wildlife protection, eco-tourism and community development.

  • Stable government job with regular salary, pension/NPS and allowances
  • Opportunity to work in forests, wildlife sanctuaries, national parks and protected areas
  • Contribution to environment protection, afforestation and biodiversity conservation
  • Good promotion avenues from Forest Guard to Forester, Forest Range Officer and higher posts in many states.

The latest National Thermal Power Corporation Limited (NTPC) Recruitment 2026 has been announced for Assistant Executive (Operation) posts! Published under Advt. No. 05/26 on the official website careers.ntpc.co.in, this recruitment drive offers 250 vacancies on a fixed-term basis. Applicants within the age limit of up to 35 years and possessing a B.E. / B.Tech degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering with relevant experience can apply online from 23 April 2026 to 07 May 2026. Find all details about the NTPC Assistant Executive new vacancy 2026, including eligibility, online application form, and notification PDF here.

NTPC Assistant Executive (Operation) Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

NTPC Limited has released the official recruitment advertisement (Advt. No. 05/26) for the post of Assistant Executive (Operation) on Fixed Term basis. The notification contains complete details regarding eligibility criteria, vacancy distribution, experience requirements, application process, general conditions, and the list of documents required. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the official notification thoroughly before filling out and submitting their online application. Incomplete or inaccurate applications are liable to be rejected without further consideration. All further addendum/corrigenda and updates will be published on the official NTPC website.

  • Download NTPC Assistant Executive (Operation) Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF (Advt. No. 05/26)

NTPC Assistant Executive (Operation) Eligibility Criteria 2026

Eligibility Criterion Details
Nationality Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply
Educational Qualification B.E. / B.Tech Degree in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering with at least 40% marks from a recognised University/Institution (SC/ST/PwBD - only pass marks required)
Experience Minimum 1 year post-qualification working experience in Operation/Maintenance of a power plant of capacity 40 MW or more

NTPC Assistant Executive (Operation) Application Fee 2026

Candidates belonging to the General/EWS/OBC category are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of ₹500/-. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD category and female candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee. Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are therefore requested to verify their eligibility criteria thoroughly before paying the application fee.

Payment can be made through online mode via Net Banking / Debit Card / Credit Card on the online application portal.

General / EWS / OBC ₹500/- (Non-refundable)

NTPC Assistant Executive (Operation) Salary / Remuneration 2026

Selected candidates engaged as Assistant Executive (Operation) on Fixed Term basis at NTPC will be entitled to a Fixed Monthly Consolidated Amount of ₹55,000/-. In addition to the consolidated pay, candidates will also receive HRA (House Rent Allowance) or Company Accommodation, Night Shift Allowance (if rostered in night shift), and medical facility for self, spouse, two children, and dependent parents.

No other allowances or perks beyond those mentioned will be admissible to fixed-term employees. The remuneration package is structured to offer competitive compensation while the candidate serves on the fixed-term contractual basis at any of the NTPC Stations, Projects, JVs, or Subsidiaries.

Fixed Monthly Consolidated Amount ₹55,000/- per month
HRA Applicable (or Company Accommodation in lieu)
Night Shift Allowance Applicable (if rostered in night shift)

NTPC Assistant Executive (Operation) Selection Process 2026

The selection process for NTPC Assistant Executive (Operation) Fixed Term Recruitment 2026 may comprise multiple stages at the discretion of NTPC management. In-order to restrict the number of candidates for further selection process, the management reserves the right to conduct multi-stage selection which may include shortlisting/screening based on qualification/percentage of marks, number of years of experience, written/computer-based test, personal interview, or a combination of the above, subject to meeting the minimum eligibility standards/criteria as per requirement.

Candidates who are shortlisted will be called for further stages. The candidate must undergo a medical examination at any of the NTPC hospitals, and the decision will be final and binding. No relaxation in prescribed health standards is allowed. Detailed medical norms are available on the official NTPC website. Candidates are advised to go through the medical norms carefully before applying.

How to Apply for NTPC Assistant Executive (Operation) Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must apply online only through the official NTPC careers website at https://careers.ntpc.co.in. No other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates are required to possess a valid email ID, as NTPC will not be responsible for bouncing back any email sent to them.

Candidates must upload all required documents while applying; applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected without further consideration. After applying online, the candidate must download the application slip generated by the system with a unique application number. A copy of the application slip may be retained by the candidate for future reference.

No document is required to be sent by post. Candidates should go through the full text of the advertisement and agree to all conditions before applying. Any canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. All disputes arising from this advertisement shall be subject to the jurisdiction of courts in Delhi only.

  • Visit the official NTPC careers website at https://careers.ntpc.co.in
  • Register and fill the online application form with accurate personal, qualification, and experience details
  • Upload all required documents as per specified format
  • Pay the application fee online (General/EWS/OBC) or through SBI offline mode
  • Download and retain the application slip with unique application number
  • Do not send any documents by post; all submissions are online only

NTPC Assistant Executive (Operation) Application Form 2026

PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Online Written Test followed by a Personal Interview, or a Personal Interview only, depending upon the number of applications received against each post. The Bank may decide to follow either of two scenarios. Under Scenario 1 (Online Written Test + Interview):

The written test consists of Part I covering Reasoning (25 marks), English Language (25 marks), and Quantitative Aptitude (50 marks) - totalling 100 marks - and Part II covering Professional Knowledge (50 questions, 100 marks), with the entire test to be completed in 120 minutes.

For each wrong answer, one-fourth of the marks assigned will be deducted as penalty. Part II (Professional Knowledge) will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify in each paper of Part I. Candidates who qualify Part I will be shortlisted for interview based on marks in Part II. Personal Interview will carry 50 marks, and candidates must score minimum qualifying marks in the interview to be considered for final selection.

The final merit will be based on aggregate scores of Part II of the Online Written Test and the Interview. Under Scenario 2 (Shortlisting + Interview): Applications will be screened, eligible candidates will be called for a Personal Interview of 50 marks, and final selection will be based solely on interview scores.
